name: zeffect_find_nearest_pick_candidate_below_point
description: zEffect::FindNearestPickCandidateBelowPoint selects the nearest DI point-query candidate below a world point.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect/zClass DI point-query source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x45a920 validates BuildPickCandidateListBelowPoint dispatch through g_zEffect_World, candidate scan, absolute vertical distance tracking, less-than-ten upward tolerance, copy of the selected 0x28-byte candidate, return 1 on hit, and return 0 when none qualifies.
The native DI point-query smoke verifies zEffect integration with g_zEffect_World and copies the below-point candidate selected from the DI world query.
